market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Fed hike bets post-162K jobs print. Oil at $97 and diesel at record create inflationary pressure. S&P 500 flat on week signals consolidation. Expect volatility around inflation data. Private credit stress (Blackstone) could trigger risk-off. AI names resilient but capex concerns linger. 1-3 month: range-bound with upside capped by rate risk, downside limited by AI earnings.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle (OpenAI AGI, Anthropic $15B, Flex data centers) supports 6-12 month tech leadership. TSMC 22% upside target credible. Energy structurally supported by geopolitical supply constraints. Consumer bifurcation persists. Fed likely to hike once then pause. TSMC > Mag 7 for risk-adjusted returns. Private credit normalization by Q1 2027. VW restructuring creates auto sector consolidation opportunity.
